subject: Lumenix connector: MSA/DPA redlines and SOC2 evidence request
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rhodes <alex.rhodes@lumenix.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumenix connector: initial contract package

Hi Alex,

Thanks for sending the materials. I skimmed the MSA/DPA/SOW and had a few high-level asks before we get legal involved:

- Can you confirm whether Lumenix is willing to cap liability at the greater of $5M or 2x fees? Our procurement team typically needs that bracket.
- Data residency: the connector will handle EU customer metadata for a subset of our customers; we need a clause guaranteeing any EU-personal data is processed only in EU regions unless we approve transfer scopes.
- Subprocessors: please provide a current list and a commitment to notify us 30 days before onboarding new subprocessors.
- SOC 2: we need either SOC 2 Type II report or a bridge letter plus an attestation of the controls covering inference logging and key management.

I attached a short list of priority redlines and a timeline request. Can we aim for a contract-ready draft by EOW (Friday)? If legal needs to do the redline exchange, looped in Vanessa and Karthik here.

Appreciate it —
Jordan
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Quick_Redlines_20260707.txt (text)]

From: Alex Rhodes <alex.rhodes@lumenix.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: partners@lumenix.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Lumenix connector: initial contract package

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear summary. We've reviewed and attached our suggested DPA and MSA with inline comments. Quick responses to your bullets:

- Liability cap: Lumenix typically proposes $2M or 1x fees; however, we can move to $5M for strategic partners — need approval from finance but likely doable.
- Data residency: we can commit to processing EU personal data in EU regions for EU customers; will add the transfer restrictions and an approval carve-out for special cases.
- Subprocessors: attached is our current list; we will add a 30-day notice commitment.
- SOC 2: we can share the latest Type II report under NDA; alternatively we can provide a bridge letter and a controls mapping for inference-specific areas.

Attachments: Lumenix_MSA_20260707.docx, Lumenix_DPA_Redlines_20260707.pdf, SOC2-Bridge-Questions.xlsx

We propose a short call on Monday to walk through the more material redlines (indemnity language, export controls, and retention). Available 9–11am PT.

Best,
Alex
Head of Partnerships
Lumenix AI
[Attachment: Lumenix_MSA_20260707.docx (docx)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Jul 2026 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Lumenix connector: initial contract package

Forwarding Alex's packet — see inline from me on positions we should take if legal asks for a playbook:

- Liability: push for 2x fees with a floor of $5M. Rationale: inference-heavy partners present higher tail risk.
- Indemnity: limited to direct damages; carve out gross negligence and wilful misconduct exceptions; no IP cross-indemnity for transformer models.
- Data retention: propose 90 days for logs unless customer mandates otherwise; require explicit retention clauses in SOW per account.
- Export controls: require Lumenix to comply with our export controls appendix and ensure they won't route inference requests through restricted jurisdictions.
- SOC2: demand Type II under NDA; if they offer a bridge letter, request specific mappings to our controls for KV cache, key management (KMS/HSM), and audit logging.

I'll draft suggested redlines and upload to the PR ticket. Karthik — can you coordinate with legal on the indemnity template?

-V
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Manager, Alliances
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Vanessa_Playbook_20260710.md (md)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rhodes <alex.rhodes@lumenix.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumenix connector: initial contract package

Alex — thanks for the packet and for being flexible on several points. A couple of concrete items before the call:

1) Can you confirm whether the SOC 2 Type II report can be shared under our mutual NDA? If yes, send to security@redwood.ai and cc me. If not, please provide the bridge letter + mapping.

2) On liability/indemnity: we'd like to see a clean line in the MSA that the liability cap is the greater of $5M or 2x fees; we'll accept a carve-out for statutory fines and will push on IP claims language so it's not broader than necessary.

3) Data residency clause: please add "Processing of EU Personal Data shall occur in EU regions only unless Redwood provides prior written consent" to the DPA. We can accept an emergency override process if staffed and logged.

4) Subprocessors: please confirm list you sent is current and commit to 30 days notice. If you can't commit, call that out so we can score procurement risk.

Call: Monday window looks tight for us — propose Tuesday 9:30am PT. If that works, please send a calendar invite and include a DocuSign pre-authorization link for signature routing (our procurement team prefers to see the final MSA + DPA ready for signature).

Cheers,
Jordan
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Proposed_Call_Agenda_20260711.txt (text)]
